vis.scope: Input MeasurementSet geometry, metadata and table sources, including SYSPOWER and CALDEVICE. Jy/K service requests also read observing metadata. TEC samples observed pointings in antenna frames. EOP reads the recorded Earth orientation per observation, antenna positions, and phase centres.

caltable.scope: CASA-readable output, cumulative corrections, and validation before replacing an existing table. Jy/K replaces the file atomically with accumulated receptor gains. TEC replaces an existing table only after the complete product is available. EOP publishes CASA-readable Fringe Jones tables and protects an existing destination when no new calibration is available.

caltype.scope: Eleven routine prior types, five switched-power types, Jy/K, TEC and EOP.

infile.scope: VLA gain curves, ALMA position JSON, Jy/K factor CSV, native CASA TEC images, IERS C04 and USNO EOP-MOD 2.0 and 2.1. The EOP default uses the installed measured IERS table.

endpoint.scope: Select the ASDM, interpolation or model-fit endpoint for Jy/K.

timeout.scope: Seconds allowed for the Jy/K HTTP connection, headers and response body.

retry.scope: Number of attempts for a Jy/K HTTP request.

retry_wait_time.scope: Seconds to wait between failed Jy/K HTTP attempts.

ant_pos_time_limit.scope: Automatic VLA correction lookup, with a strict archive-day cutoff and the whole-second posting boundary.

spw.scope: Spectral-window selection and output axes. Switched-power modes validate the selector and derive their grid from SYSPOWER. Jy/K uses this selector for service factors. Factor files provide their own selection. TEC validates the selector then derives the full solution grid and publishes it on SPW 0. EOP writes the windows present in each scan.

antenna.scope: Ordered IDs and expressions, all-antenna defaults, and applicable automatic lookup. Switched-power modes validate the selector and keep the full antenna grid. Jy/K takes antenna selectors from its factor source. TEC validates the selector then derives corrections for all antennas. EOP writes the antennas present in each scan.

pol.scope: Ordered receptor behavior for the applicable routine types. Both receptors are generated in the five switched-power modes. Jy/K takes receptor labels from its factor source. The F Jones table stores one line-of-sight coefficient per antenna for both receptors. EOP writes the same phase, delay and rate in both receptors.

parameter.scope: Scalar or vector corrections, CASA cycling and family-specific units. The five switched-power modes derive values from the MS subtables. Jy/K gains come from the factor source. TEC uses a sole value as the shell height in kilometres. Other vector lengths select the 450 km default. EOP derives values from the change in Earth orientation.

uniform.scope: Both antenna-grid policies for scalar and spectral SYSCAL. Switched-power modes consistently use the full antenna grid. Jy/K fills the same G Jones grid for both settings. The TEC table follows the full antenna and time grid for either setting. EOP keeps its observation and scan grid for either setting.

behaviors.title: Routine prior tables and calibrated data
behaviors.scope: Compare generated calibration parameters, selections, flags, weights and applied visibilities in both writer-reader directions.
behaviors.gap: Compared with the installed CASA reference.

behaviors.title: Antenna offsets and service inputs
behaviors.scope: Direct vectors, legacy rotated coordinates, ALMA file input and automatic VLA archive corrections, including historical tropospheric delays.
behaviors.gap: Compared with the installed CASA reference.

behaviors.title: VLA switched-power gains and visibility weights
behaviors.scope: Generate, overwrite and apply CASA G EVLASWPOW tables from SYSPOWER and CALDEVICE for the five switched-power modes. Preserve the separate visibility gains and Tsys weight factors and share application with solver preapply.
behaviors.gap: Compared with the installed CASA reference.

behaviors.title: ALMA Jy/K factor files and service
behaviors.scope: Read receptor-specific CSV factors and generate CASA-readable G Jones tables with cumulative positive gains. Compare queries, calibrated tables and fallback for ASDM, interpolation and model fit. Test the public ASDM service separately.
behaviors.gap: Dedicated dataset-scale performance validation remains in #979.

behaviors.title: Ionosphere correction from a vertical TEC cube
behaviors.scope: Interpolate TEC in world coordinates and convert it to line-of-sight electron content. Apply dispersive phase and Faraday rotation across both feed bases without scaling weights.
behaviors.gap: Dedicated dataset-scale performance validation remains in #979.

behaviors.title: Earth-orientation corrections and fringe rate
behaviors.scope: Calculate phase, delay and rate from recorded Earth orientation and IERS or USNO updates. Use recorded observation and scan geometry, including attached ephemerides. Apply CASA-readable Fringe Jones tables to data and solver inputs.
behaviors.gap: Dedicated dataset-scale performance validation remains in #979.

decisions.record: Explicit gencal wildcards can index outside the calibration array
decisions.inputs: An explicit whole-axis wildcard, a negated antenna index, or an empty legacy VLA antenna selection.
decisions.casa: Some of these selections abort the process when they index a nonexistent table element.
decisions.ours: Whole-axis selections broadcast, and invalid negative antenna indices raise a task error.
decisions.rationale: Prevent native crashes and preserve prior calibration products.
decisions.impact: Explicit and equivalent all-antenna selections produce the same intended correction.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: Opacity priors can index a nonexistent second receptor
decisions.inputs: A scalar opacity table with a second-receptor or two-receptor selection.
decisions.casa: Indexes a nonexistent second receptor and terminates the task process.
decisions.ours: Raises a task error and preserves the existing product.
decisions.rationale: The opacity coefficient is scalar and the requested selection cannot be applied.
decisions.impact: Empty and first-receptor selectors remain usable.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: A one-receptor SYSPOWER shape aborts switched-power calibration
decisions.inputs: One receptor per SYSPOWER measurement or a SYSPOWER timestamp between visibility scans.
decisions.casa: A malformed receptor shape aborts. An empty scan match is dereferenced and returned 0 in the oracle.
decisions.ours: Refuses malformed shapes before publication and assigns unknown scan -1 to timestamps without a matching scan.
decisions.rationale: Avoid process termination and retain physical measurement timestamps.
decisions.impact: Usable SYSPOWER samples retain their actual times. Samples with no matching visibility scan carry an unknown scan ID.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: Invalid Jy/K factors can publish unflagged nonfinite gains
decisions.inputs: Zero or negative factors, or repeated factors exceeding the representable gain range.
decisions.casa: Can publish unflagged nonfinite or zero complex gains.
decisions.ours: Refuses the correction before publishing either a fresh or updated product.
decisions.rationale: An unusable gain can corrupt calibrated visibilities.
decisions.impact: Usable gains retain CASA multiplication and selector semantics.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: A flagged F Jones coefficient can leave unflagged visibilities
decisions.inputs: A circular-feed F Jones table with the last antenna flagged at every epoch.
decisions.casa: Leaves that antenna with a unity gain and unflagged baseline outputs.
decisions.ours: Flags baselines with an unavailable correction when the apply mode writes flags.
decisions.rationale: Preserve the validity of calibrated visibilities when a term is missing.
decisions.impact: Valid solutions continue to apply using CASA science and flags.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: An empty EOP result can delete an existing calibration table
decisions.inputs: An existing Fringe Jones table and a missing input file or input without matching Earth orientation updates.
decisions.ours: Keeps the existing table and only publishes a complete replacement.
decisions.rationale: Preserve prior calibration products on input failures.
decisions.impact: A missing input still raises FileNotFoundError. No matching Earth orientation leaves a diagnostic and preserves any prior product.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

decisions.record: EOP interpolation can ignore later daily samples
decisions.inputs: An observing epoch after the fourth day in a daily Earth orientation series.
decisions.casa: Caps the upper sample index at three and extrapolates from earlier samples.
decisions.ours: Brackets the observing epoch using the available samples.
decisions.rationale: Prevent a stale polar-motion or UT1 correction despite available matching data.
decisions.impact: The seven-epoch fixture agrees with an independent ERFA delay calculation.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing CASA bug policy in AGENTS.md.

specified.kind: Specified G Jones and K Jones corrections
specified.scope: 31 comparisons cover ordered selectors, both calibration families, precision and cumulative updates. An incompatible grid preserves all 12 existing solutions.

vla-priors.scope: 25 comparisons cover standard, explicit and embedded curve data, sparse antennas and gains with and without weight calibration. Sixteen tables agree exactly.

tsys.scope: 14 comparisons cover both uniform settings, selected image-channel weights, floating-point temperatures, retuned windows and safety of linked SYSCAL inputs.

opacity.scope: 16 comparisons cover spectral windows, ordered antennas, receptor behavior, cumulative updates and cross-application. Eleven calibration tables agree exactly.

manual-positions.kind: Manual antenna coordinates and ALMA files
manual-positions.scope: 24 comparisons cover direct ITRF and legacy VLA coordinates, ALMA JSON, moving field reference epochs, forced SPW zero and shared input protection. Thirteen tables agree exactly.

vla-archive.kind: Frozen and live VLA archive correction
vla-archive.scope: Frozen comparisons cover correction dates, moves, a day cutoff, service failures and the 2016B tropospheric keyword. The live archive yielded the same 3 mm eastward component for ea01 in both products.

alma-service.kind: Frozen and live ALMA position service
alma-service.scope: The two clients send matching valid queries, select hosts in the same order, and produce matching antenna data and request metadata. The live case agrees on all ten antennas. Cross-engine files produce exact gencal tables.

performance.scope: Representative end-to-end throughput, I/O and compute phases, workers and memory.
performance.result: Scheduled for the programme performance qualification in #979.

switched-power.kind: Pinned same-input products and table interchange
switched-power.scope: All five VLA switched-power, weights and requantizer modes, both writer-reader directions, solver preapply and invalid data controls.
switched-power.result: Five native and CASA generation modes and 96 writer-reader applications passed.

jyperk.kind: Pinned CASA task products and writer-reader interchange
jyperk.scope: Read receptor-specific CSV factors and generate CASA-readable G Jones tables with cumulative positive gains. Compare queries, calibrated tables and fallback for ASDM, interpolation and model fit. Test the public ASDM service separately.
jyperk.result: Weighted application and solver preapply pass through all four writer-reader pairs. Separate live ASDM test agrees for SPW 17.

tecim.kind: Pinned F Jones generation, weighted application and solver preapply
tecim.scope: Native Float TEC images with daily and absolute time, nonidentity transforms, signed shell heights, public tasks, calibration libraries, flag handling and both feed bases.
tecim.result: LOS TEC normalized RMS below 7e-8. Corrected visibility and solver preapply RMS below 3.2e-5 across matched writer-reader combinations.

eop.kind: Pinned Fringe Jones generation, application and solver preapply
eop.scope: Four input sources, short C04 lines, descending channels, attached ephemerides, observation isolation, atomic publication, a late-epoch ERFA control, and a rate-only off-epoch control.
eop.result: Phase and delay agreed exactly for the four source variants and the moving target fixture. Rate normalized RMS stayed below 4.1e-8. Corrected visibility and solver preapply RMS stayed below 9.3e-7 across all four writer-reader pairs.
